item.subject: science
item.stem:
Meena notices the old stone wall near her school in Jaipur slowly wearing away over many years. Three statements about these slow natural changes are listed. Which statements are correct?

1  Rainwater flowing over the stones wears them down without forming any new substance, so this is a physical change.
2  When wind carries small soil particles away from the ground, a new substance is formed, so this is a chemical change.
3  Cracks in the stones widening due to daily heating and cooling is a physical change because no new substance is produced.

statements.text: Rainwater flowing over the stones wears them down without forming any new substance, so this is a physical change.
When wind carries small soil particles away from the ground, a new substance is formed, so this is a chemical change.
Cracks in the stones widening due to daily heating and cooling is a physical change because no new substance is produced.
